scope: Compact project opening and setup guidance
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--folder-failure-compact-dar.task: Open a folder and review errors or setup guidance without excessive headings.
conversation--folder-failure-compact-dar.observations: Folder label has a consistent gutter below the heading. Input, Browse and footer actions fit both sizes. The failure state keeps the selected path, clear focused error and nearby Try again, with readable contrast in both appearances.
